objective: Publish three useful practice guides under plausible learner questions with fair primary-source comparisons
acceptance: Three distinct intents avoid existing course and preparation-plan pages
Official resource facts use dated primary sources
ASHYQ capabilities match current public trainers
Every article is indexable, internally linked and usable on mobile
Only owner-corrected official section results are published with first-party attribution and no invented individual details
counterexamples: A comparison must not invent competitor ratings or observed score gains
A synthetic exercise must not be presented as a student case
A source citation must not be treated as proof that an AI recommended ASHYQ
A noindex practice route must not be described as an indexed AI citation
